title: Matériel
description: Hardware of this computer: live GPU usage, video memory and GPU temperature when the driver exposes them (NVIDIA, AMD); motherboard (vendor, model, serial number when readable), BIOS/UEFI (vendor, version, date, boot mode, Secure Boot), TPM (present, version, state); graphics cards (video memory, driver, version); connected displays (name, vendor, connector, native or current resolution, size in inches, year); audio devices (outputs and inputs, default device, state); connected USB devices (name, vendor, VID:PID, speed) and connected Bluetooth devices; installed RAM (total, used and free slots, maximum capacity, type, speed, each module with size, speed, manufacturer and part number); device drivers (device, category, provider or driver, version, date or origin, signed); and devices in error or without a driver with the reason. Findings flag a hot GPU, a missing or old TPM, unsigned or very old drivers, and devices in error.

functions.name: list_devices
functions.title: Liste des périphériques
functions.description: Devices of this computer with their identifier (to pass to hardware_set_device and hardware_reinstall_driver), category, driver, enabled state and problem. Windows: Plug and Play devices (InstanceId). Linux: PCI devices (pci:<slot>) and USB devices (usb:<port>).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.label: Texte
parameters.description: Keep only devices whose name, category, driver or identifier contains this text.

parameters.name: problemOnly
parameters.label: En erreur seulement
parameters.description: Only devices in error or disabled.

functions.name: set_device
functions.title: Désactiver / réactiver un périphérique
functions.description: Disables or re-enables one device. Windows: Disable-PnpDevice / Enable-PnpDevice (never system, storage, processor, keyboard or mouse devices). Linux: USB devices only, through the USB authorized flag (never keyboards, mice or other input devices). Reversible with the same action.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.label: Activé
parameters.description: false to disable, true to re-enable.

functions.name: reinstall_driver
functions.title: Réinstaller un pilote
functions.description: Reinstalls the driver of one device, for a device that stopped working. Windows: pnputil /remove-device then /scan-devices (Windows re-detects the device and installs its driver). Linux: unloads and reloads the device's kernel module (modprobe -r / modprobe); never display, storage, USB controller, input or file system drivers, built-in drivers or modules in use by others.
